LLMModelSelectionSettingsModel.description: Named / run-scoped model pack applied via ``llm_models`` profiles.

mode.description: Use one shared model for all LLM consumers, or pick per consumer.
mode.title: Mode

shared_model.description: Model tag used in shared mode (and as per-module fallback).
shared_model.title: Shared Model

module_models.description: Optional per-consumer Ollama model tags when mode is per_module.
module_models.title: Module Models

LLMModelSelectionSettingsModel.title: LLMModelSelectionSettingsModel

description: Canonical field definitions for LLM provider configuration.

enabled.description: Enable LLM-backed analysis modules when provider is available.
enabled.title: Enabled

provider.description: LLM provider id (`null` disables remote calls; `ollama` uses a local server; `openai_compatible` is an opt-in Chat Completions endpoint). Never a silent cloud default — set llm.base_url explicitly. API keys come from TRANSCRIPTX_LLM_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY, not this field.
provider.title: Provider

fallback_model.description: Secondary Ollama tag used when the preferred model returns unusable JSON (empty response / parse failure). Leave empty to disable fallback.
fallback_model.title: Fallback Model

preferred_failure_threshold.description: After this many preferred-model JSON failures in one warm/analysis run, remaining JSON calls use only the secondary model.
preferred_failure_threshold.title: Preferred Failure Threshold

json_prefer_think_off.description: When True, JSON-format Ollama requests send think=false if the model advertises that thinking can be disabled (/api/show).
json_prefer_think_off.title: Json Prefer Think Off

base_url.description: Provider base URL (Ollama e.g. http://localhost:11434/; openai_compatible e.g. http://127.0.0.1:4000/v1). Required for openai_compatible — there is no cloud default.
base_url.title: Base Url

request_timeout.description: Per-request timeout in seconds for LLM calls.
request_timeout.title: Request Timeout

availability_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds when probing provider availability.
availability_timeout.title: Availability Timeout

seed.description: Default seed for reproducible generation where supported.
seed.title: Seed

max_input_chars.description: Maximum characters of transcript text sent to the LLM after prompt wrapping.
max_input_chars.title: Max Input Chars

default_temperature.description: Default sampling temperature for modules that do not override per call.
default_temperature.title: Default Temperature

active_model_profile.description: Active llm_models profile name (virtual default when unset).
active_model_profile.title: Active Model Profile

model_selection.description: Resolved model pack from the active llm_models profile.

title: LLMSettingsModel
